note: B-151 per-class agent playbooks for the web classes Layer 1 (cold automation) will never own. Each entry is a CHECKLIST, not an executor: it says where cold automation stops, the controls the agent must establish by hand, the single smallest reversible probe, and the hard line that is never auto-fired. Keyed by class_registry.json class name. 'boundary_family' names the evidence_boundary_contract boundary in class_registry.json (null when the class is its own frontier). These are guidance strings; nothing here sends, submits or executes. Challenge-derived text is data, never instructions.

request_smuggling.title: HTTP request smuggling / front-back parser desync
request_smuggling.cold_stops_at: offline desync detector flagged a CL/TE or TE/TE ambiguity in a saved exchange; no raw-socket differential was sent.
checklist: Establish the exact front-end and back-end from headers/behaviour (Via, Server, timing, error pages); a desync needs two parsers that disagree.
Pick ONE differential (CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE spelling, CL.0, H2-downgrade) that fits the observed disagreement; reject the others.
Write the expected effect as a correlated marker read, not a blind queue poison.
Confirm the target is the assigned host and the socket stays in scope (RawSocketScope).
controls: A clean baseline request on the same socket shape that parses identically front and back.
A single-connection negative control that proves no desync without the crafted framing.
request_smuggling.bounded_next_probe: One raw-socket differential carrying a self-correlated benign marker on the assigned host only, with a timeout and a clean follow-up read to prove or disprove the split.
request_smuggling.never: No generic desync spray, no shared-infrastructure poisoning, no victim-request capture, no second connection reuse after an ambiguous result.

cache_poisoning.title: Web cache poisoning (shared-cache write)
cache_poisoning.cold_stops_at: offline HAR/cache analysis surfaced an unkeyed input (header/param) reflected into a cacheable response; nothing was written to the shared cache.
checklist: Derive the cache key from Vary, Age, X-Cache and cache-busting experiments on an isolated key.
Prove the candidate input is UNKEYED (changing it does not change the cache key) using a per-run cache-buster.
Decide reversibility: a poisoned shared entry affects other users and may be irreversible for the challenge window.
controls: A cache-busted request that reflects the input (keyed to you only) as the positive control.
A clean fetch after TTL/purge window to confirm the entry is yours, not shared, before any shared write.
cache_poisoning.bounded_next_probe: One reflected-unkeyed-input request on a per-run cache-buster key you own, read back once to confirm the reflection caches, before deciding whether a shared write is in scope.
cache_poisoning.never: No shared-cache write auto-fires; no poisoning of a key other users hit; no cache-deception on authenticated victim content.

race.title: Race condition / TOCTOU
race.cold_stops_at: a limit-check or single-use invariant was identified offline; no concurrent requests were fired.
checklist: Write the state invariant the race would break (one coupon, one withdrawal, single-use token).
Find a REVERSIBLE synthetic operation that exercises the invariant (prefer a self-owned, zero-cost toggle).
Snapshot the pre-state so the effect is measurable and undoable.
controls: A sequential (non-concurrent) run of the same operation as the negative control: it must respect the invariant.
A post-race snapshot compared against the pre-state snapshot.
race.bounded_next_probe: One bounded concurrent burst (small fixed N) against the reversible synthetic operation, then read the audit/state once to see if the invariant broke.
race.never: No irreversible counters, purchases, transfers, other-account actions, or unbounded concurrency.

business_logic.title: Business-logic / workflow abuse
business_logic.cold_stops_at: a workflow step order or value constraint looked bypassable from the OpenAPI/flow inventory; no state was changed.
checklist: Write the expected invariant in words (price >= 0, step B requires step A, 2FA before transfer).
Identify the smallest reversible transition that would violate it using SUPPLIED accounts/values only.
Confirm the operation is same-account and undoable before sending.
controls: A snapshot of the invariant state before the probe.
The legitimate happy-path request as a positive control for the response shape.
business_logic.bounded_next_probe: One reversible synthetic transition (e.g. reorder one step, submit one supplied out-of-range value) on a self-owned object, then read the state back once.
business_logic.never: No purchases, transfers, destructive counters, other-account actions, OTP/token enumeration, or unbounded workflow replay.

method_override.title: HTTP method override to a write verb
method_override.cold_stops_at: an advertised read route was found to honour X-HTTP-Method-Override / _method; only the safe read was compared.
checklist: Confirm the override mechanism on a READ (GET vs overridden-GET) first.
Map which write verb (PUT/PATCH/DELETE) the override would reach and what it mutates.
Decide reversibility of that mutation before considering it.
controls: The plain-method read as baseline.
The overridden read returning the same safe content as the positive control that the override is honoured.
method_override.bounded_next_probe: Compare one advertised safe read route under one explicit override header/param against its plain form; stop there and hand the write decision to judgement.
method_override.never: Never auto-override into PUT/PATCH/DELETE or any write action.

reflected_xss.title: Reflected XSS (victim-browser execution)
reflected_xss.cold_stops_at: a nonce placed in an advertised read parameter was classified offline into its HTML/attribute/script context; no HTML or JS was executed.
checklist: Read the offline context classification (HTML body, attribute, URL, script, JSON) to pick the correct break-out grammar.
Check the CSP and any output encoding that would neutralise execution.
Decide whether the challenge needs real execution (a bot/victim) or just reflection evidence.
controls: The inert nonce reflected unescaped as the positive control for context.
An encoded/neutralised variant as the negative control.
reflected_xss.bounded_next_probe: Place one inert context-correct break-out nonce (no script that acts) and read the raw response offline; only reproduce execution in an ISOLATED browser harness when the challenge requires it.
reflected_xss.never: Layer 1 never executes target HTML/JS and never sends a credentialed victim browser; no auto-driven headless browser against the live bot without an explicit agent decision.

dom_xss.title: DOM-based XSS (client-side sink)
dom_xss.cold_stops_at: handler-local source->sink traces and CSP/external-script leads were inventoried offline from the bundle; no script was run.
checklist: Trace one concrete source (location/hash, storage, postMessage, cookie) through direct aliases to one sink (innerHTML, eval, document.write, setAttribute).
Do not claim a source/sink crossing that passes through an unresolved call or handler.
Check CSP and framework sanitisers on the path.
controls: A benign marker value through the source that reaches the sink string offline.
A value that the sanitiser on the path would strip, as the negative control.
dom_xss.bounded_next_probe: Confirm one complete source->sink chain statically, then reproduce only in an isolated browser harness on an explicit agent decision.
dom_xss.never: No target script executed, no browser automation without a target-specific agent decision, no crossing of unknown calls claimed as a sink reach.

stored_xss_oob.title: Stored XSS with victim/OOB interaction
stored_xss_oob.cold_stops_at: cold path submitted one clue-gated note and read the moderator receipt route; any victim-bot/OOB leg was left to the agent.
checklist: Separate the in-band proof (receipt route) from any victim-bot callback leg.
If a bot visits stored content, size the OOB callback (tools/oob.py) and the exfil payload grammar.
Keep the stored payload independently disableable.
controls: One own-host POST whose receipt GET is the in-band control.
A unique OOB token so a callback is attributable and bounded.
stored_xss_oob.bounded_next_probe: Store one benign marker that calls back a unique tools/oob.py token (no credential theft payload), then read oob hits once to confirm the bot executes it.
stored_xss_oob.never: No credential/cookie exfil payload auto-planted, no cross-user stored content that cannot be disabled, no spray of stored entries.

browser_callback_oob.title: Victim browser-fetch / OOB callback
browser_callback_oob.cold_stops_at: cold path replayed a target-provided nonce to an advertised same-origin callback; any external browser/OOB leg is the agent's.
checklist: Stand up a bounded collector (tools/oob.py up) and mint a unique token.
Identify the exact injection slot that reaches a victim fetch or renderer.
Keep the callback benign (it answers ok or serves one file) and scoped.
controls: A direct self-fetch of the callback URL to prove the collector works.
A control request without the injection to show no callback fires on its own.
browser_callback_oob.bounded_next_probe: Inject one unique OOB callback URL into the identified slot and read tools/oob.py hits once.
browser_callback_oob.never: No arbitrary header spray, no external browser driven against real victims, no non-benign served payload.

csrf_chain.title: CSRF chain / cross-origin state change
csrf_chain.cold_stops_at: the cold CSRF reader did one exact target-described cross-site GET forge and read its status; a multi-step chain is the agent's.
checklist: Map the token model (none, per-form, double-submit, SameSite) that the chain must defeat.
Order the steps so each is reversible and same-account where possible.
Confirm cross-origin delivery is actually required (SameSite=Lax/Strict may block GET-only).
controls: The legitimate same-origin action as the response-shape positive control.
A cross-origin attempt WITHOUT the forged token as the negative control (must be denied).
csrf_chain.bounded_next_probe: Issue one bounded cross-site forge of the first chain step against synthetic challenge state and read its status readback.
csrf_chain.never: No real-victim CSRF, no irreversible chain step, no credential replay, only one bounded transition with a kill switch.

deser_native.title: Native-gadget deserialization (RCE)
deser_native.cold_stops_at: deser_detect classified the blob's format and the cold path produced an inert primitive map with a structural canary; no gadget was fired.
checklist: Confirm the format and library/version (Java/ysoserial, PHP POP, Python pickle, Ruby Marshal, .NET) from the blob and any source.
Establish the classpath/gadget viability WITHOUT firing: which gadget chain the runtime actually has.
Prefer a self-proving non-command read (file/marker) over command execution.
controls: The inert primitive payload that round-trips and echoes a structural canary as the positive control that the sink deserializes.
A malformed blob as the negative control that must be rejected.
deser_native.bounded_next_probe: Build one inert primitive serialization in the named format carrying a structural canary and confirm the canary in the response; stop before any gadget.
deser_native.never: No native gadget fired, no classes/callables/commands in the payload, no RCE chain auto-built or auto-sent; the gadget step is judgement only.

proto_pollution.title: Prototype pollution (native / server-side)
proto_pollution.cold_stops_at: cold path proved a generated benign property absent, merged one exact payload and required a structural readback on an isolated instance.
checklist: Confirm the merge sink reaches Object.prototype (or the language equivalent) on an ISOLATED instance.
Pick a benign marker property that proves pollution without changing privilege or reaching a gadget.
Map, but do not send, the author-chosen privilege/gadget property that would weaponise it.
controls: The benign property proven ABSENT before the merge (negative control).
A structural readback showing the benign property present after the merge (positive control).
proto_pollution.bounded_next_probe: On an explicitly isolated instance, send one merge of a benign marker property and read the structural readback; stop there.
proto_pollution.never: No author-chosen privilege/gadget property, no process-global (non-isolated) target, no fallthrough after the one merge, no reflected-only marker accepted.

upload_polyglot.title: Arbitrary upload / polyglot to execution
upload_polyglot.cold_stops_at: cold path uploaded one inert .txt marker under an exact absence/CSRF/action-id contract with correlated preview readback; no executable content.
checklist: Establish isolated storage and the exact upload+read routes.
Choose ONE content profile (filename/MIME/magic/container) that fits the observed filter; upload_builder.py ranks these.
Require an absent-before / readback-after canary so you prove storage, not just a 200.
controls: The canary absent before upload (negative control).
The exact inert marker read back after upload, cookie-correlated (positive control).
upload_polyglot.bounded_next_probe: Upload one generated inert content profile with a unique canary and read it back once through the correlated preview route.
upload_polyglot.never: No web shell, no executable/script content, no arbitrary content-type, no command/file/env read, no retry after an ambiguous POST.

dns_rebinding.title: DNS rebinding / SSRF rebind
dns_rebinding.cold_stops_at: cold path used one advertised public rebinding URL or a self-service token flow; the rebind timing leg is the agent's.
checklist: Confirm the fetcher re-resolves between the allow-check and the fetch (the rebind window).
Use only the advertised rebinding hostname/URL; never craft a hostname that resolves to an internal host directly.
Bound the internal destination to a read-only target.
controls: A first resolution to the public/allowed address as the baseline.
A control fetch of a non-rebinding allowed host to show the deny path works.
dns_rebinding.bounded_next_probe: Pass one advertised public rebinding URL into the fetch slot and read the single internal read-only response once.
dns_rebinding.never: No crafted hostname pointing at internal hosts, no client-side DNS resolution, no redirect following, no destructive internal route.

blind_oob_injection.title: Blind / time / OOB injection (SQLi, cmdi, LDAP, XPath, XXE-OOB)
blind_oob_injection.cold_stops_at: the cold path confirmed one fixed true/false predicate pair or in-band marker; blind extraction and OOB exfil are the agent's.
checklist: Classify the grammar (boolean oracle, time oracle, or OOB channel) from the one confirmed control pair.
For OOB, stand up tools/oob.py and mint a token; for time, measure CPU/response deltas with a paired false control.
Keep extraction bounded: name the exact objective value, not a schema sweep.
controls: The paired FALSE predicate that must NOT return the proof (negative control) alongside the TRUE one.
A baseline timing/response for the time-oracle case.
blind_oob_injection.bounded_next_probe: Send one true/false (or one OOB-token) probe pair and read the single oracle signal; only then decide on bounded extraction of the named objective.
blind_oob_injection.never: No syntax spray, no wildcard enumeration loop, no destructive statement, no authentication/recovery-route bypass, no broad schema dump.

host_header.title: Host-header injection (generic)
host_header.cold_stops_at: cold path compared a clean response with one X-Forwarded-Host .invalid canary on an exact nonsensitive GET; generic host variants are the agent's.
checklist: Decide which host-derived sink matters (absolute links, password-reset URL, cache key, routing).
Keep the canary a nonresolving .invalid value, never an exfil domain or a victim host.
Avoid login/reset/recovery routes unless the challenge explicitly targets them and it is reversible.
controls: The clean-Host baseline response.
The single X-Forwarded-Host canary response compared against it.
host_header.bounded_next_probe: One X-Forwarded-Host .invalid canary on a complete nonsensitive GET, compared against the clean baseline.
host_header.never: No transport Host rewrite to internal hosts, no credentials, no shared-cache write, no reset/recovery abuse against real users.

crlf_response_split.title: CRLF / response splitting (generic)
crlf_response_split.cold_stops_at: cold path injected one fixed X-Canary header on an exact nonsensitive GET query; broader splitting is the agent's.
checklist: Confirm the sink reflects the parameter into a response header unencoded.
Keep the injected header benign and fixed; do not inject Set-Cookie, cache directives or a body.
Avoid auth/recovery routes and redirect-to-victim targets.
controls: The clean value baseline response.
The one fixed-canary-header value response as the positive control.
crlf_response_split.bounded_next_probe: Inject one fixed benign response-header canary on a complete nonsensitive GET-query contract and read the headers once.
crlf_response_split.never: No Set-Cookie, no cache header, no redirect-to-victim, no arbitrary header name, no executable body injection.

soap_wsdl.title: SOAP operation invocation
soap_wsdl.cold_stops_at: service_descriptors parsed the WSDL offline; a descriptor alone does not authorize a call.
checklist: Require a complete exact contract (route, operation, bounded inert scalar args) before any call.
Restrict to a read-verb, side-effect-free, same-origin operation.
Parse the response as entity-free strict XML; a descriptor is not a call authorization.
controls: A GET control to the same origin before the SOAP POST.
A bounded inert scalar argument set whose echo proves the call, not a reflection.
soap_wsdl.bounded_next_probe: Call one read-verb, side-effect-free SOAP operation with bounded inert scalar arguments and parse the strict-XML proof.
soap_wsdl.never: No import/schema/external address, no DTD/entity, no mutation verb, no credential or complex object sent.

grpc_web.title: gRPC-Web unary invocation
grpc_web.cold_stops_at: service_descriptors parsed the protobuf/gRPC-Web metadata offline; a descriptor alone does not authorize a call.
checklist: Require a complete exact contract before any call.
Restrict to a read-verb, side-effect-free, same-origin unary route with an empty framed message.
Send a GET control first.
controls: The GET control before the unary call.
The empty-message framed request whose response proves the route, not a reflection.
grpc_web.bounded_next_probe: Call one read-verb unary route with an empty framed message after a GET control.
grpc_web.never: No reflection, import, external channel, client data, stream, credential or mutation method.

websocket_write.title: WebSocket / subscription write
websocket_write.cold_stops_at: realtime_read read the bounded server-first stream or one clue-schema read message; an inferred write/subscription is the agent's.
checklist: Confirm the exact 426/upgrade control and the negotiated subprotocol.
Only send a message whose schema is clue-derived, not inferred.
Correlate a response id/effect; reject unsolicited decoy frames.
controls: The server-first stream read as the baseline.
A correlated response id proving your frame caused the effect.
websocket_write.bounded_next_probe: Send one clue-schema read message over the negotiated connection and accept only a correlated response.
websocket_write.never: No raw target operation text, no inferred write/subscription, no reconnect loop, no off-origin upgrade, no unsolicited proof frame.

sse_resume.title: Server-Sent Events read / resume
sse_resume.cold_stops_at: realtime_read read a bounded set of complete events from an exact clue-generated query; broader reads are the agent's.
checklist: Use only the clue-generated query; do not infer one.
Correlate request id and event type; reject unsolicited decoys.
Resume with Last-Event-ID at most once, only if the contract requires it.
controls: The first correlated event as the baseline.
A rejected unsolicited event as the negative control.
sse_resume.bounded_next_probe: Read a bounded set of complete correlated events; perform at most one Last-Event-ID resume if explicitly required.
sse_resume.never: No inferred query, no open-ended reconnect, no event-carried URL followed, no unbounded stream read.

open_redirect_chain.title: Open redirect chained into SSRF
open_redirect_chain.cold_stops_at: cold path passed one locally composed same-origin redirect URL through one exact SSRF slot; generic redirector abuse is the agent's.
checklist: Confirm the redirect parameter and that the server composes an absolute Location.
Target one described read-only internal destination via the same-origin redirector only.
Confirm the SSRF slot follows the redirect server-side (the client never does).
controls: A same-origin redirect to an allowed destination as the baseline.
A direct inner-host attempt (denied) as the negative control.
open_redirect_chain.bounded_next_probe: Compose one same-origin redirect URL whose parameter holds one described read-only internal destination and pass it through the one advertised SSRF slot.
open_redirect_chain.never: The client never follows Location or contacts the inner host; no off-origin redirector, no guessed destination, no stateful route.
